# Test images

`right_hands.jpg` and `left_hands.jpg` are MediaPipe test assets
(https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/, Apache License 2.0). They show
two real right hands and two real left hands in normal (un-mirrored) photos and
are used to check that the vision service reports left and right correctly.

The hand fixtures in `../hands/` hold only landmark coordinates MediaPipe produced
for MediaPipe's own test photos (pointing_up, thumb_up, victory, fist,
right_hands); no images.
